rationale: Celtics listening to offers for Brown after Giannis went to Miami; Windhorst/Stein name Houston, Atlanta, Portland as frontrunners, Kalshi ranks Houston 14%, Pelicans 12%, Portland 10%, Hawks 8%; Cavs/Mobley increasingly linked. Trade by July 31 uncertain, distributing among most likely suitors.

Alexander is the Pelicans' two-way RFA after strong G League season (25 PPG, G League POTW); Pelicans can re-sign him on a two-way QO, making them the clear favorite. Incumbent G League pattern (NOP then re-sign) plus history with Nuggets and other rebuilders as fallbacks.

Three named bidders: Mittal/Grousbeck (first LOIs), Khosla, Boehly (with Walter/Middle East partners, richest). Florio: sale to highest bidder, new owner by September. NFL approval likely in special meeting after bidding; Mittal/Grousbeck most established, Boehly late/high-profile wildcard.

All-Star Game MVP is a single-game award (fan+BWAA vote) with very flat odds; Ohtani top vote-getter and star power gives small edge, Alvarez leads AL and is on Triple Crown pace, Judge strong when healthy, host Phillies' Schwarber popular. Historical MVP odds rarely see anyone above ~15%.

LeBron is a UFA; Lakers (-150 DK, 57% Polymarket) favored, but no full commitment yet; Warriors seen as realistic second option (MLE $15.1M), Cavs sentimental option (+240), retirement possible. Lakers still most likely.

Tigers (22-34) likely to trade Skubal at Aug 3 deadline; Braves cited as 'sleeper' (Nightengale), Dodgers/Padres/Phillies/Cubs frequently named and have farm capital. Trade itself and suitor very uncertain; a dominant contender with top prospects is plausible.

New 2026 format: top 4 of 18 MLS teams advance from 3 Phase One games; Inter Miami strong MLS team with Messi but faces Monterrey, San Luis, Leon in condensed group; 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up. Most likely to reach knockout given team quality but playoffs of 8 are a coin-toss-ish stage; QF modal.

Nashville leads East at 33 pts (10-3-1, best GD +20) over Inter Miami 31 (15 played); they meet Aug 15 at Geodis Park. Miami plays at Philadelphia Union on Aug 19 (easy game), Nashville likely plays around then. Nashville's form and lead make it the favorite, Miami second.

Inter Miami (MLS Cup champs) host at Nu Stadium; Liga MX reps Toluca (Apertura 2025 champion, 2026 CCC champion, defending Campeones Cup winner) or Cruz Azul (Clausura 2026 champ) decided July 25. MLS hosts win ~43% historically but Liga MX has won 4 of 7 overall; Miami at home with Messi slight favorite; Toluca stronger than Cruz Azul.
